column1: # Deskripsi skill — keluarga mekanik putaran keempat.

# --- varian kondisi tile yang belum tertutup ---
^When attacking a target on an? (\w+) tile, (\w+) tile or a Polyphase tile derived from either of these, damage dealt is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat menyerang target di tile \1, tile \2, atau tile Polyphase turunan salah satunya, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: # --- akumulasi per-instans ---

^For (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)each</color> instance of damage dealt by ally units, damage is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>, to a maximum of (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Untuk \1tiap</color> damage yang diberikan unit sekutu, damage meningkat sebesar \2\3%</color>, hingga maksimal \4\5%</color>.

column1: ^For every (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) instances?</color> of damage dealt outside of own turn, increase damage dealt by the next active attack by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Setiap \1\2 kali</color> damage diberikan di luar giliran sendiri, damage serangan aktif berikutnya meningkat sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^For every (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)one instance</color> of out-of-turn attack is performed, damage dealt by out-of-turn attacks is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>, to a maximum increase of (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$

column1: ^(<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)Each time</color> an out-of-turn attack is launched, the damage of out-of-turn attacks is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>, to a maximum of (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$

column1: ^(<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)Each time</color> (\w+) damage is dealt, \2 damage dealt is further increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>, to a maximum increase of (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$

column1: # --- kondisi elemen & jarak ---
^Before an allied unit attacks, if the target has (\w+) debuff\(s\), (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\w+) damage</color> dealt is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$

column1: ^After using active skills on an allied unit, critical damage dealt by this unit is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> for (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) rounds?</color>\.$

column1: ^If the debuff is a defense debuff, an additional (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)</color> debuff is applied for (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) turns?</color>, and the damage of the next active skill is further increased by an additional (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
